short_name.description: Short descriptive name of the item (e.g. 'DHT22 Temperature Sensor', 'M3x10 Hex Bolt')

consumable.description: True if the item is used up during normal use (e.g. solder, screws, zip ties, filament). False for reusable tools and equipment.

description.description: Concise description of the item, its purpose and typical use cases in a makerspace context

tags.description: Lowercase categorisation tags relevant to the item (e.g. ['electronics', 'sensor', 'i2c', 'temperature'])

price_new.description: Current retail price in euro cents (e.g. 1999 for €19.99). Null if unknown.

price_used.description: Approximate second-hand value in euro cents. Null if unknown.

model_number.description: Manufacturer model or part number visible on the item or packaging
